Chapter 779: Chapter 6: Dual Realm Of Time-Space Fusion Rules (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 779: Chapter 6: Dual Realm of Time-Space Fusion Rules (Subscribe Please)

The transfer of resources valued at two hundred billion cubic universe crystals to Lin Yuan was not a matter of moments.

It required mobilization from various major star domains, and considering the vast expanse of the human civilization territory, even continuous wormhole shuttle would take a considerable amount of time.

However, Lin Yuan was not in a hurry.

The cultivation of “Body of Xuanhuang” could be done gradually....

Currently, Lin Yuan did not feel the pressing need to cultivate “Body of Xuanhuang” to perfection.

Virtual world.

Lin Yuan was having a casual conversation with his parents. “Have you been finding more free time recently?”

Lu Qiong looked at Lin Yuan and couldn’t help but say, “You should take seriously what I told you. Lin Yi has great-grandchildren now, and here you are, still single.”

More than a hundred years ago, Lin Yi married Xia Keren from the Xia Family of humans.

In the second year of their marriage, they had children and now even had great-grandchildren.

The reproductive speed of humans was indubitable; if it weren’t for the Xia family’s strict management of their descendants, they could easily have multiplied to seven or eight generations within a hundred years. “No rush.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Reproducing offspring is to place one’s hopes on the next generations.

But Lin Yuan? His hopes and goals didn’t need to be entrusted to descendants; he could accomplish them himself. “Still not in a hurry?”

Lu Qiong sighed. They were now evolvers who could easily live for thousands to tens of thousands of years, but this matter had nothing to do with how long one lived. “Son, at least have some children and keep us company.”

Lu Shoucheng also spoke, “Your mom and I are too bored now; having grandchildren would help pass the time.” “I’ll consider it.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Reproducing offspring does not necessarily require a partner.

With the current level of human civilization’s technology, external reproduction is completely feasible. …

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In front of him floated a luminous orb, endless insights on the spatiotemporal fusion rules continuously flooding into his mind. “Time-space… so this is time-space?”

Lin Yuan was immersed in comprehension, forgetting the passage of time.

Indeed, even if the spatio-temporal fusion rule insights of the Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses were placed before him, most beings would find it tough to fully grasp them; however, Lin Yuan, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, absorbed and comprehended these insights at an astoundingly rapid pace.

This was also why the half-meter tall old man was shocked when Lin Yuan had just started and immediately grasped the spatiotemporal fusion rules. “Spatio-temporal fusion rules… Dual Realm.”

Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes, his aura transforming; time-space fusion vaguely formed a spatial-temporal maze around him.

Now, with Lin Yuan’s understanding of the spatiotemporal fusion rules, other powerhouses who got close would be trapped in the spatial-temporal maze, unable to escape.

The spatial-temporal maze was much more terrifying than a mere time prison. “Three years, I finally elevated the spatiotemporal fusion rules to the Dual Realm.”

A smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face; originally, he had spent decades and still failed to comprehend the spatiotemporal fusion rules.

Now, with the help of the luminous orb in front of him, his speed of comprehension was incredibly fast. “Hmm?” “The inner world is also becoming more stable.”

After reaching the Dual Realm of the spatiotemporal fusion rules, Lin Yuan faintly felt subtle changes in his inner world. “These three years, apart from elevating the spatiotemporal fusion rules to the Dual Realm, the ten fusion rules on the black planet have also been successively elevated to the Fourth Realm.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The reason for such swift comprehension was still due to the insights from the Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses.

The twelve pillar-level fusion rules on the black planet, combined with the insights from the Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses, naturally enabled quick comprehension. …

Black planet.

The man in the black robe silently watched Lin Yuan’s incarnation walking out from the last Guiding Space, the emotions surfacing in his heart growing rapidly.

Originally, he thought that Lin Yuan advancing a realm every fifty years in the fusion rules was incredibly unbelievable, but in the last two to three years, the speed of Lin Yuan’s insights had increased dramatically.

Is he still a being from this universe? “The final fusion rule has now been elevated to the Fourth Realm, so this black planet is no longer very effective for me,” Lin Yuan noted, standing outside the Guiding Space while taking a deep breath, thinking to himself. “It’s a pity that among the twelve pillar-level fusion rules, there is no spatiotemporal fusion rule; otherwise, it would have been much more beneficial to me,” Lin Yuan felt somewhat regretful.

But then again, he deemed it only natural.

The spatiotemporal fusion rule, even for a Supreme Being, represents a foundation, a cornerstone.

To segment part of the spatiotemporal fusion rule insights and create a Guiding Space would be too costly for a Supreme Being.

For other fusion rules, segmenting them out is just that; if necessary, they could simply be comprehended again.

But the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule? Even if it could be comprehended again, before it was re-comprehended, it would greatly affect one’s own strength.

If there really is a Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule Guiding Space on the black planet, then its value could skyrocket by hundreds or even thousands of times.

Other Evolvers from Human Civilization, if they want to enter the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule Guiding Space, would need to pay far more than one hundred million Merit Points. “We can lease out the remaining eleven Guiding Spaces.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that the lease price for one Guiding Space was one hundred million Merit Points, so eleven Guiding Spaces would amount to one point one billion, equivalent to a Ninth-Level Citizen.

And this was only the price for one lease; once this batch of Evolvers had finished their comprehension, it would be another new round of one point two billion Merit Points.

At this moment, Lin Yuan also realized the true value of the black planet—it was an inexhaustible mine of gold and silver.

Even as Human Civilization grew increasingly powerful and the number of Tenth Rank Evolvers increased, the price to enter and comprehend on the black planet could be raised even higher. …

Outside the Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s purchase of resources valued at two hundred billion cubic Yuan had finally arrived. “Galaxy Master.”

The one transferring these resources was a Grade A Tenth Rank, showing respectful demeanor.

Lin Yuan could sense that eyes of Eleventh-Rank Evolvers were watching.

Two hundred billion Cubic Universe Crystals were enough to warrant the protection of an Eleventh-Rank Evolver. “The quantity is correct.”

Lin Yuan roughly counted them, then put them into his Inner World.

Star Lord’s Great Hall.

After the Eleventh-Rank Evolver had left.

Lin Yuan’s mind moved slightly, and his true form entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm through the Xuanhuang Seal.

As for the Milky Way Main Star? It was overseen by the Taiyang Divine Spirit. …

Deepest part of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan’s true form sat cross-legged. “Tenth Rank ‘Body of Xuanhuang’ at Complete Level…”

Xuanhuang Qi flowed within Lin Yuan’s body, spreading the Xuanhuang Force Field throughout his surroundings spanning thousands of miles. “Start the breakthrough.”

Without hesitation, Lin Yuan began to operate the “Body of Xuanhuang,” absorbing the vast resources before him.

Thunderous rumbles.

The mighty energy was devoured into his body, and Lin Yuan’s body underwent rapid changes, becoming denser, his blood and organs subtly circulating an immortal essence. “The stronger the physical body, the greater its nourishment to the spirit and will, even significantly affecting the Inner World.” “Ninth Rank, Tenth Rank, Eleventh Rank Evolvers, most of their foundation lies in the Inner World, but in truth, the physical body is key; without a strong body, how can one sustain a vast Inner World?” “The Inner Universes of Supreme Beings reach tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of light-years; do the bodies harboring such vast universes seem frail?”

The more Lin Yuan comprehended the changes in his body, the deeper his insights became, and that’s why the Tenth Rank Martial Tao Chapter, valued at five billion Merit Points, positioned the Martial Path Evolutionary Path close to the peak of the Supreme Evolution Path.

This was because the essence of the Tenth Rank Chapter returned to the physical and spiritual essence, which Lin Yuan had developed after comprehending the physical and spiritual essence of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

Time slowly passed.

After half a month, Lin Yuan’s purchase of two hundred billion cubic Universe Crystals worth of vast resources was almost completely depleted.

At this moment, Lin Yuan had finally reached the Complete Level of the “Body of Xuanhuang.”

Twelfth Rank “Body of Xuanhuang” at Xuanhuang Level, even among Supreme Beings, was considered extremely powerful; otherwise, it wouldn’t dare claim it could withstand the Great Universe’s cataclysm.

Although Lin Yuan was only at the Tenth Rank, having cultivated the “Body of Xuanhuang” to completion, his Tenth Rank was naturally different from others. “My current strength, if relying solely on physical strength, probably the second tier of Eleventh-Rank Life, would be suppressed by me,” Lin Yuan mused, examining his physical strength.

Lin Yuan’s physical body was incredibly strong, a strength manifesting not only in his physical vigour but in defense as well, being near perfect. Blood Rebirth combined with the Elemental Body made him virtually invincible.

At this moment, even if Lin Yuan stood without moving, second or even third tier Eleventh-Rank Life probably couldn’t harm him.

Even if they could barely breach his defenses, Lin Yuan could quickly recover. “Try it.”

Lin Yuan started to release the suppression of his physical body, and the terrifying power of his physical vigor and blood began to recklessly stir everything within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm. … “Is the master in seclusion this time to cultivate the ‘Body of Xuanhuang’?”

On the other side of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, a Six-Armed Silhouette stood there, feeling the huge fluctuations of Qi and energy from Lin Yuan’s seclusion spot, feeling somewhat trembled. “Shouldn’t the master be just at Tenth Rank? Why is his Xuanhuang Force Field so terrifying?”

The Six-Armed Silhouette found it hard to believe, as the spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, it carried many memories of the former Xuanhuang, and knew about the various stages of the “Body of Xuanhuang.”

But now, the commotion caused by Lin Yuan’s cultivation was a bit too much, the Tenth Rank “Body of Xuanhuang” at Complete Level was almost no different from the Eleventh Rank “Body of Xuanhuang” at Complete Level. “Following the current cultivation trend of the master, when he steps into the Eleventh Rank and cultivates the ‘Body of Xuanhuang’ to completion, wouldn’t he approach the Twelfth Rank’s Completion Level of the ‘Body of Xuanhuang’?”

The Six-Armed Silhouette felt its spirit trembling.

Even nearing the Twelfth Rank’s Completion Level was incredibly unbelievable, if not standing shoulder to shoulder with ultimate entities, at least it could last dozens or even hundreds of moves in front of them.
